title: Kulka-BetterCooldowns
description: A lightweight and customizable HUD mod to track item cooldowns with ease.
body:
Kulka's Better Cooldowns

Better Cooldowns is a lightweight Fabric mod designed to enhance your gameplay by providing a clear and customizable HUD for item cooldowns. No more guessing when your Ender Pearl or Shield is ready!

Features:

    Full Inventory Tracking: Displays a cooldown entry for every item on cooldown anywhere in your inventory, not just the hotbar, stacking multiple entries vertically.

    Draggable HUD Editor: Instead of typing in coordinates, open the position editor and simply drag a live preview of the cooldown display to wherever you want it on screen.

    Scaling: Adjust the size of the HUD from 0.5x up to 3.0x to fit your interface perfectly.

    Seconds or Percentage Display: Toggle between a percentage-based progress readout (with or without decimals, e.g. "45%" or "45.3%") and a countdown in seconds (e.g. "15.0s").

    Customizable Background: Pick your own background color and adjust its transparency from fully opaque to fully invisible.

    Optional Item Names: Show the item's name next to its icon and cooldown value, including custom/renamed items.

    Mod Menu Integration: Easy-to-use configuration screen (requires Mod Menu and YetAnotherConfigLib).

Configuration:

To open the configuration menu, you need to have Mod Menu installed. Click on the "Configure" button in the mod list to adjust:

    Enable/Disable Mod: Quickly toggle the entire mod on or off.

    Edit HUD Position: Opens a dedicated screen where you drag the cooldown preview to its new position and save.

    Scale: Slider from 0.5x to 3.0x.

    Use Seconds: Switch between percentage and seconds display.

    Percentage Decimals: When using percentage display, choose between whole numbers or one decimal place.

    Background Color: Pick any color for the HUD background.

    Background Transparency: Slider from 0% (opaque) to 100% (fully transparent).

    Show Item Name: Toggle displaying the item's name alongside its cooldown.

Requirements:

To run this mod, you need:

    Fabric API

    YetAnotherConfigLib (YACL) v3

    Mod Menu (optional, required only for the in-game configuration screen)
